title: GoHighLevel AI Employee Pricing 2026: $50, $97 or Pay-Per-Use
description: GoHighLevel AI Employee pricing: $50 Growth vs $97 Unlimited vs pay-per-use, what each tier includes, and the charges that never go away.
html_content:
GoHighLevel's AI Employee costs $50/month (Growth) or $97/month (Unlimited) per location, or you can pay per use with no monthly fee — as of July 2026. The $97 tier includes unlimited Voice AI, Conversation AI, Reviews AI, and Content AI, subject to fair use. Two things the sticker price doesn't say: phone-system charges apply on every call no matter which tier you're on, and the add-on price sits on top of a GoHighLevel plan at $97–$497/month. Here's the whole bill, itemized.

This page is part of a series: the full AI Employee review covers what the product actually does; this page is just the money.

How much is a GoHighLevel AI Employee?

Three ways to pay, all per enabled location (sub-account), from GoHighLevel's AI Product Pricing doc as of July 2026:

PlanPriceWhat's included
Pay-Per-Use$0/monthNo monthly fee; every AI action bills at unit rates (below)
AI Employee Growth$50/month100 Voice AI minutes + 1,000 Conversation AI responses/month; Reviews AI and Content AI unlimited; overages bill at pay-per-use rates
AI Employee Unlimited$97/monthUnlimited Voice AI, Conversation AI, Reviews AI, Content AI — subject to fair use; 3× the included Ask AI / AI Studio usage

The unit rates, when you're paying per use (or past the Growth caps):

  • Voice AI: a $0.045/minute Voice Engine rate (effective May 20, 2026) plus text-to-speech ($0.015–$0.170/min depending on voice) plus model tokens. The Voice AI pricing page breaks this down per call.
  • Conversation AI: billed by model tokens (e.g. GPT-5 at $1.25/1M input tokens, $10/1M output).
  • Reviews AI: $0.01 per review.
  • Content AI: $0.063 per image and $0.0945 per 1,000 words.

Is the $97 unlimited plan actually unlimited?

Mostly yes — with three honest caveats:

  1. Fair use. GoHighLevel reserves the right to throttle, limit, or terminate access if usage is "excessive, abusive, or negatively affects platform performance." For a normal business answering its own calls, you will not hit this. If you're reselling AI minutes at scale, read it closely.
  2. Phone charges never go away. GoHighLevel states it directly: "Phone System charges still apply to all phone calls regardless of plan." Telephony (LC Phone or Twilio) is a separate meter on every tier.
  3. Agent Studio isn't in the bundle. The custom agent builder is pay-per-use on every plan — the $97 tier does not include it. Details on the AI Agent pricing page.

Worth knowing: this structure is newer than most reviews. Until mid-2026, Voice AI was metered on every tier and "$97 all-in" was genuinely wrong. After the restructure, the $97 tier really does cover unlimited voice usage. If a review tells you voice is always metered, it's describing the old pricing.

Which AI Employee plan should you pick?

Run the math on your call volume — honestly, because the crossover comes later than most reviews imply:

  • Voice alone, standard voice: pay-per-use runs about $0.06/minute in engine + speech fees plus tokens. That means 100 minutes costs about $6–7, and pure pay-per-use stays cheaper than the $97 Unlimited tier until roughly 1,500 voice minutes a month. Versus Growth: $50 covers 100 minutes, then overage at the same rates — Growth plus overage passes $97 at roughly 900 total minutes.
  • Premium voices move the crossover way up: an ElevenLabs V3 voice bills $0.215/minute in engine + speech fees, so Unlimited pays for itself past roughly 450 minutes a month.
  • The bundle is the real reason to pick a tier: Growth's $50 also covers 1,000 Conversation AI responses, unlimited Reviews AI, and unlimited Content AI — usage that all meters separately on Pay-Per-Use — and Unlimited caps the whole AI bill at $97 no matter what the month looks like.
  • Genuinely tiny or experimental usage: Pay-Per-Use costs nothing monthly. Good for testing an agent before committing.

One more line item to plan for: the base platform. The add-on requires a GoHighLevel subscription — $97 Starter, $297 Unlimited, or $497 Agency Pro. If you're comparing the whole stack against other platforms, the full GoHighLevel pricing guide itemizes plan-level costs.

Can agencies rebill the AI Employee to clients?

Yes — that's a core part of the pitch. Rebilling with markup is part of SaaS mode on the $497 Agency Pro plan, and GoHighLevel's AI Employee doc shows an example of an agency rebilling the $97 add-on at a custom $297 price — about 3× cost. If you're a business owner buying through an agency, that markup is what pays for their setup and management; if you'd rather set it up yourself, signing up directly skips it.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a GoHighLevel AI employee per month?

$50/month (Growth) or $97/month (Unlimited) per location as of July 2026, or pay-per-use with no monthly fee. All three sit on top of a GoHighLevel plan ($97–$497/month), and phone charges are always separate.

Is GoHighLevel AI Employee worth $97 a month?

It depends on voice choice and volume: with premium ElevenLabs voices past roughly 450 minutes a month, or standard voices past roughly 1,500 minutes, Unlimited beats paying per use — and heavy chat, reviews, or content usage moves the crossover earlier because those meter separately on pay-per-use. Below those volumes, Growth at $50 or pure pay-per-use costs less. The full review covers when the product itself is the right call.

Does the $97 AI Employee plan include phone call costs?

No. Phone-system (telephony) charges bill separately on every tier — the $97 covers AI processing, not carrier minutes or phone numbers.

Is there a free trial for the AI Employee?

The AI Employee is an add-on inside GoHighLevel, and GoHighLevel itself offers a free trial — the extended version is 30 days. You can enable AI features and test them on real calls during the trial.
